node.title: L1 FPC5: large-source full-petal payment
node.statement: Aggregate every first-owned FPC5 contributor on the remaining large source scales M>=5,13,29,57 at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16 after the exact proved prefilter (PF6) and official-rate scale-gap theorem. Every survivor has both a proved affine anchor chart and an anchor-free weighted Cauchy divisor chart whose coefficient space is a full-rank rational Pade-Hankel kernel; when u>=0, every fixed required background u-set gives exactly ell-1 Hankel rows and monic codimension ell-1. The core split predicate and primitive punctures are equivalently one explicit generalized-Vandermonde support-determinant system with nonzero Cramer amplitudes. Exact constant-weight shortening now supplies a field-independent cap for every fixed GRS shell and, at n=8192, pays the complete rate-1/8 M=29..32 and rate-1/16 M=57..67 prefixes on printed upper field slices. Owner cancellation separately reduces co-deficiency c to a primitive touched-petal determinant AV-CU=Lambda K with deg K at most c. The conclusion is one disjoint polynomial/profile allocation across the surviving source layouts, touched-petal sets, background sets, determinant tails, and exact owners.
node.attack_surface: apply the exact GRS support-shortening cap before any split-pencil attack; at n=8192 on its printed upper field slices the first unpaid scales are M=5,13,33,68 at rates 1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16, while other rows retain their own exact cutoffs; then prove a base-field-normalized point bound and component classification for the explicit generalized-Vandermonde support system, retaining nonzero Cramer amplitudes and exact background guards, coalesce fixed background sets, and supply a collective first-owner theorem; the exact ambient MDS census realizes every top owner, so no owner-coordinate or unguarded linear argument can suffice
node.falsifier: an official large-source first-owned FPC5 family exceeding every polynomial and legitimate quotient/profile column
